cues.en: The last method that I will introduce you to in this section is called the logit lens.

cues.en: and in particular, how each token or token embedding vector gets slowly transformed into a prediction for the subsequent token.
cues.zh: 尤其是每個 token、每個 token 嵌入向量，如何逐漸轉成後續 token 的預測。

cues.en: It's also like lots of other analyses you learn about in this course, quite versatile in the sense
cues.zh: 它也像這門課學到的其他許多分析一樣，非常靈活，

cues.en: that there's a lot you can do once you understand the basic framework of how this analysis works.
